note: This file is the reference. Every rule cites the guideline it comes from so a human can verify it against the source. Store policies change; re-read the sources and bump `reviewed` at least twice a year. A rule with mode `auto` is enforced by code in rules/checks/. A rule with mode `manual` cannot be decided from the repo — it is a store-console or human-judgement item, and must be attested by a person. Each manual rule carries a `validity` block saying what makes its answer go stale — the version moving on (`always`), a fingerprint changing (`signal`), or time passing (`expiry`). An answer is carried forward until then, so a release only re-asks what actually changed. See lib/validity.js.

sources.title: Target API level requirements for Google Play apps
Provide information for Google Play's Data safety section

rules.title: No placeholder or unfinished content
rules.requires: Submissions must be final. Placeholder text, 'coming soon' screens and dead-end buttons read as an incomplete app and are rejected.

rules.title: Working demo account for review
rules.requires: If any part of the app is behind a login, App Review Information must carry credentials that work at submission time, or the reviewer cannot get in and rejects under 2.1.
rules.prompt: Confirm the demo account in App Store Connect > App Review Information signs in RIGHT NOW on the build being submitted, and that any OTP path a reviewer hits is documented in the notes.

rules.title: App name, subtitle and keywords describe the app
rules.requires: Name, subtitle, screenshots and description must reflect what the app actually does. Irrelevant keywords or competitor names are rejected.
rules.prompt: Confirm the App Store listing name, subtitle, description and keywords match what this build actually does — no unshipped features described, no competitor names in keywords.

rules.title: No mention of other mobile platforms
rules.requires: App metadata and in-app content must not reference Android or other platforms.

rules.title: Digital goods must use In-App Purchase
rules.requires: Unlocking features or content inside the app must go through IAP. Linking out to an external payment page for digital content is rejected.

rules.title: Consumer lending apps must disclose loan terms
rules.requires: Apps offering personal loans must disclose the maximum APR, repayment period and a representative cost example, and must not exceed 36% APR.
rules.prompt: This app touches lending. Confirm whether it offers loans TO the end user (consumer lending — triggers 3.2.2(vii) disclosure and the 36% APR cap) or is a back-office record-keeping tool for a lender's own books (does not). Record which, and the reasoning, in the submission notes.

rules.title: More than a repackaged website
rules.requires: An app that is only a web view of an existing site, with no native capability, is rejected.

rules.title: Sign in with Apple offered alongside other social logins
rules.requires: An app using a third-party social login (Google, Facebook) as its only or primary sign-in must also offer an equivalent privacy-preserving option such as Sign in with Apple.

rules.title: Privacy policy link present and reachable
rules.requires: Every app must link to a privacy policy, both in App Store Connect and inside the app where it collects data.

rules.title: Permission purpose strings describe real, app-specific use
rules.requires: Every NS*UsageDescription must explain in the app's own words what the app does with the data. Framework defaults and vague one-liners are rejected.
rules.history: Sone Taran 2.0.0 was rejected for shipping Expo's default 'Allow $(PRODUCT_NAME) to access your camera'.

rules.title: In-app account deletion
rules.requires: An app that supports account creation must let the user start account deletion from inside the app — not only deactivation, and not only via a support email.

rules.title: App Store privacy labels match actual behaviour
rules.requires: The privacy 'nutrition label' in App Store Connect must match what the app and its SDKs actually collect. A mismatch is grounds for removal.
rules.prompt: Open App Store Connect > App Privacy and confirm every data type this build collects is declared — including anything third-party SDKs collect on your behalf. Cross-check against the analytics events this app sends.

rules.title: Privacy manifest present and populated
rules.requires: Apps must ship a privacy manifest declaring collected data types and any required-reason APIs. An empty manifest in an app that collects data contradicts its own privacy labels.

rules.title: ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption declared
rules.requires: Without this key every upload halts and waits for a manual answer to the encryption question.

rules.title: Build number is unique and consistent
rules.requires: The build number must be higher than any previously uploaded build for this version, and identical across all build configurations.
rules.history: Builds 1 and 2 of SoneBill were consumed by failed attempts; build 3 was rejected on upload for reuse.

rules.title: Bundle executable name is ASCII
rules.requires: CFBundleExecutable / PRODUCT_NAME must be ASCII. The user-visible CFBundleDisplayName may be localised.

rules.title: iPad icons present when iPad is enabled
rules.requires: An iPad-enabled app must include the 76x76 and 83.5x83.5 icons in its asset catalog.

rules.title: iPad declares all four orientations
rules.requires: An iPad-enabled app must declare all four interface orientations, including PortraitUpsideDown.

rules.title: No cleartext HTTP or dev-server plumbing in a shipping build
rules.requires: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads, Expo Bonjour discovery and http:// endpoints must not ship in a release build.

rules.title: Screenshots for every required device size
rules.requires: Screenshots must be supplied for the required iPhone display sizes, and for iPad if the app is iPad-enabled. They must show the real app, not marketing mockups of unshipped features.
rules.prompt: Confirm App Store Connect has screenshots for every required size (including iPad if supportsTablet is on), taken from THIS build, showing features that actually ship.

rules.title: Age rating questionnaire matches app content
rules.requires: The age rating questionnaire must reflect actual app content and any user-generated or web content.
rules.prompt: Confirm the age rating questionnaire still matches what this build contains.

rules.title: UGC apps need filtering, reporting and blocking
rules.requires: Apps with user-generated content must provide a content filter, a report mechanism, a way to block abusive users, and published contact information.
rules.prompt: Confirm the app ships content reporting, user blocking and a moderation path — all three are required, not just one.

rules.title: targetSdkVersion meets Play's current floor
rules.requires: New apps and updates must target a recent API level. Play refuses the upload outright below the floor.

rules.title: versionCode is higher than the live release
rules.requires: Every upload needs a versionCode strictly greater than any already released on the track. Play rejects duplicates and regressions.

rules.ref: Permissions and APIs that Access Sensitive Information
rules.title: No undeclared or unexpected permissions in the merged manifest
rules.requires: Permissions must be justified by app functionality. Autolinked libraries commonly inject permissions the app never intended to request.

rules.ref: Permissions and APIs that Access Sensitive Information
rules.title: Restricted permissions require a declaration
rules.requires: SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES, MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, SMS/Call Log, background location and AD_ID each need a Play Console declaration and an approved use case.

rules.ref: Device and Network Abuse / security best practice
rules.title: Cleartext traffic disabled in release
rules.requires: usesCleartextTraffic must be false in a release build, and no http:// endpoints should ship.

rules.title: Data safety form matches actual behaviour
rules.requires: The Data safety form must declare every data type collected or shared, including by third-party SDKs, and must match the app's privacy policy.
rules.prompt: Open Play Console > App content > Data safety and confirm every collected/shared data type in this build is declared, matches the privacy policy, and matches the iOS privacy labels.

rules.title: In-app deletion plus a public web deletion URL
rules.requires: Apps allowing account creation must offer in-app deletion AND a web-accessible deletion request URL declared in Play Console — the web URL is a Play-only requirement Apple does not have.

rules.title: Deletion URL declared in Play Console
rules.requires: The web deletion URL must be reachable without installing the app and declared under Data safety.
rules.prompt: Confirm the public account-deletion URL is live, reachable while logged out, and entered in Play Console > Data safety.

rules.title: Privacy policy URL in Play Console and in the app
rules.requires: A privacy policy URL is required in the store listing and must be reachable in-app.

rules.title: Lending apps need a Financial Services declaration
rules.requires: Personal loan apps must complete the Financial Features declaration and, in some regions including India, supply licensing documentation. Undeclared lending apps are suspended.
rules.prompt: Play Console > App content > Financial features. Declare whether this app offers personal loans to consumers or is a business record-keeping tool. Leaving it blank on a lending-adjacent app risks suspension.

rules.title: IARC content rating questionnaire completed
rules.requires: An app without a completed content rating questionnaire is removed from Play.
rules.prompt: Confirm the IARC questionnaire is complete and still accurate for this build.

rules.title: AD_ID permission matches the ads declaration
rules.requires: Apps targeting API 33+ that use the advertising ID must declare AD_ID; apps that do not use ads must not request it.

rules.title: Listing, screenshots and feature graphic reflect the app
rules.requires: Store listing assets must depict actual app functionality. Misleading screenshots are a Deceptive Behavior violation.
rules.prompt: Confirm Play listing screenshots, feature graphic and description match what this build actually does.

rules.title: Reviewer sign-in instructions provided
rules.requires: If content sits behind a login, Play Console > App access must carry working credentials and steps.
rules.prompt: Confirm Play Console > App content > App access has working credentials for this build, including how to get past any OTP.

rules.title: Foreground services declare a type and justification
rules.requires: Apps targeting API 34+ must declare a foregroundServiceType for every foreground service and justify it in Play Console.

rules.ref: Security review / Play Device and Network Abuse
rules.title: No API keys or secrets committed in source
rules.requires: Shipping credentials in the bundle exposes them to anyone who unpacks the app. Both stores treat leaked backend credentials as a security defect.

rules.title: Version-control API key is set for the release build
rules.requires: The Nexus API key lives in a gitignored secrets.ts whose template defaults to an empty string, so a release can be built with no key at all. That is what happened to 1.0.15: version checks were rejected and engagement telemetry disabled itself for twelve days, and neither could be fixed without another store release. A build that cannot authenticate cannot be told anything.

rules.title: No personal data in analytics event payloads
rules.requires: Sending names, phone numbers or emails as analytics parameters must be declared on both stores' privacy forms — and usually should not happen at all.
rules.history: Flagged during the SoneBill 1.0.10 review and deferred to the next release.

rules.title: No dev endpoints or debug switches in a release build
rules.requires: localhost URLs, staging endpoints and debug menus reaching production are a common cause of a reviewer seeing a broken or blank app.
